verdict.rationale: Meltano projects are plain code. Plugins and pipelines are defined in the project file (meltano.yml), and the docs explicitly say you can treat a project like any software project, using version control, code review and CI/CD. This covers versioning and review of automations through standard git workflows. Rollback is only implied by version control, and the whole flow relies on external git tooling rather than a native feature. missing for 10: explicit documented rollback or revert of pipeline and state changes, native in-product version history or review UI, independent or hands-on corroboration of a git-based review and rollback workflow.
